"""Abstention carrier: rule-3 tri-state on an unresolved external base.

``ShimOverExternal`` inherits an external base the analysis cannot
resolve, and nothing proves ``maybe_called`` is called - measured: the
method row carries ``abstained: true`` (and no live_root_reason; the two
are mutually exclusive by contract).
"""

import argparse


class ShimOverExternal(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    def maybe_called(self) -> str:
        return "shim-answer"
